source: knowledge/x/caption-patterns.md (CP-01..16, templates T01-T41: our own phrasing of the patterns measured in 1,375 design captions of Marcel Kargul, rico, Basit, uisabor, Flo, Mariana, Oguz, Paco, rauno, Steve Schoger, Jim Raptis and Augustas's own posts; data knowledge/benchmarks/x-strategy-2026-10/data/_captions.json) and knowledge/x/caption-voice.md (CV-01..14, the house rules). The X-engine posts on @rokasrem, @faulkner_Design and @marius_vanagas are negative evidence and were never used (XS-28). A hand-written line in library/<project>/<asset>/caption.md always wins over a template. {vars} come from the asset manifest's captionVars; a caption with an unfilled {var} is flagged 'needs words', never posted.
register: Studio register for every account: lowercase, 5-9 words (3-10 allowed), one measured pattern per caption (superlative about a named part, 'this {part} ...' callout, first-person reaction, view label, standard line, comparative follow-up, named label), never explanatory product copy (what the design does, decided or gave up), never a question, never the fictional brand name, never 'concept' in the post (it goes in the first reply). Accounts differ by pattern rotation and subject lane, not by writing explanations.

relations.first: the first post of an asset, or a series start
relations.follow: a series step 2+ that quotes the previous step (CV-13, XS-16); the caption carries a comparative relation cue (CP-09)
relations.second: the same image again after 7-60 days (XS-18); new words, same or a stronger pattern (CP-16)
